maya: Quick follow-up from INC-5423 postmortem. Main asks: make a compact playbook template for KV-cache evictions, add exact triage commands, and define a rotating owner for runbook maintenance. Also want an automated creation of a remediation ticket if the pattern repeats. Please claim pieces + ETA.

sanjay: I can author the playbook template and add the triage + mitigation commands. ETA: 2026-03-30. Will include expected outputs and rollback bullets.

tess: I'll validate the commands in staging and add a short validation checklist (smoke metrics to check after evict).

ev an: I'll wire the alert -> ticket automation and add a ticket template that includes owner, ETA, and sprint link. ETA: 2026-03-31. Suggestion: ticket auto-assign to a rotating oncall owner tag `runbook-rotating-owner`.

jun: I'll propose the rotation cadence and add a maintenance reminder to the calendar. My plan: 90-day owner rotation, ops lead does quarterly audit.

ops-bot: Created INF-8123 and linked to postmortem: https://tickets.redwood/INF-8123 (playbook templating + automation).

sanjay: Draft playbook snippet (to go into runbooks/playbooks/kv-evict.md):
```yaml
playbook: KV cache eviction
version: 1.0
triage_steps:
  - name: collect-logs
    cmd: kubectl -n inference logs -l app=redwood-runtime --since=30m | grep -i KVCache
  - name: identify-pod
    cmd: POD=$(kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=redwood-runtime -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
  - name: evict
    cmd: kubectl -n inference exec -it $POD -- /bin/sh -c "curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:9090/debug/cache/evict"
mitigation_notes: |
  Expected response: {"status":"ok"}
  If evict causes >1% 5xx in next 5m, revert and notify infra.
```

(tess): I'll run those commands in staging tomorrow morning and paste validation notes here.

sanjay: Also adding a short FAQ entry: "When not to evict" -> if large batch jobs are running, coordinate with owners to avoid compounding load.

ev an: Alert pseudo-rule I'll wire (Datadog):
```
alert_name: KV_EVICT_PATTERN
condition: count(eviction_signature{service:inference} by 24h) >= 3 OR increase(inference_service.p99[10m]) > 180
action: create ticket INF-8123 - auto-assign tag:runbook-rotating-owner; page infra-oncall
```

(ev an): Ticket template fields I'll attach to auto-created tickets: owner, proposed ETA (48h), playbook link, recent logs link. This makes follow-ups consistent.

jun: Rotation plan: add `runbook-rotating-owner` group; owners rotate every 90 days; ops-bot will post reminder 2 weeks before handoff. I'll create calendar event template and update OWNERS file in runbooks repo.

ops-bot: INF-8123 updated: subtask INF-8123-1 (playbook template) -> sanjay; INF-8123-2 (staging validation) -> tess; INF-8123-3 (alert wiring + ticket template) -> evan; INF-8123-4 (owner rotation + calendar) -> jun. Link: https://tickets.redwood/INF-8123

sanjay: PR opened: https://git.redwood/runbooks/pull/521 — includes the new playbook template and FAQ. Please review.

tess: Validated in staging: evict returned {"status":"ok"}, `kv_cache_entries` metric dropped ~14%, no 5xx spike in 10m. Added validation notes to PR.
ev an: Wired alert to Datadog and tested auto-ticket creation. Test ticket created with `runbook-rotating-owner` tag and proper template fields.
jun: OWNERS file updated: added rotation schedule and initial owner list. Ops-bot reminder scheduled.

sanjay: PR merged: https://git.redwood/runbooks/commit/7c3f2b — playbook live. Marking INF-8123-1 done.

maya: Great job. Next steps: 1) confirm alert runs without false positives for 7 days, 2) run first owner handoff in 2 weeks, 3) add quarterly drill to validate the playbook end-to-end. Putting tasks on INF-8123.

ev an: Monitoring window started. Will post a short report after 7d.

jun: Handoff invite sent to owners for 2026-04-06.

(1 week later)
ev an: Monitoring report: one alert fired (test event), no auto-ticket from production. No false positives. Will keep monitoring.

sanjay: Noted one minor wording nit from drill notes, opened tiny follow-up PR to clarify rollback phrasing.

maya: Closing loop for now. If automation or rotation reveals gaps, we will reopen INF-8123. Thanks team! :white_check_mark:
